definition.evidence: example_exports/gls_exported/pixel/dx_5_0/uber (12.1.0 client, all 26 variants): the switch on cb2[4].x that sets diffuse and emissive, and the alpha-test switch that sets alpha
definition.notes: Not expressible here: a parallax offset from height texture t17 (at uv1) along a tangent frame built from screen derivatives offsets t3 (at uv1) and t4 (at uv2); diffuse = lerp(t3*t3.a + t4, t2, t17.g), then toward t0 (uv0) by v3.w where v3.w > 0; emissive = t1 (at a further generated uv) * t2.rgb*t2.a (also blended toward t0 by v3.w) plus the parallax layers. Alpha 1.
